tasks.subject: Task 1: Core App — design system violations
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fix all design system violations in core app pages and their CSS modules.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/products/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/stocktake/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/component-detail.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/warehouse/locations/page.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/goods-inwards.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/bom/templates/templates.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] products/page.tsx PageHeader has eyebrow=Products
- [ ] stocktake/page.tsx PageHeader has eyebrow=Operations and title=Stocktakes
- [ ] components/page.tsx uses EmptyState
- [ ] products/page.tsx uses EmptyState
- [ ] component-detail.module.css uses danger tokens
- [ ] warehouse/locations/page.module.css uses ink tokens
- [ ] goods-inwards.module.css uses shadow-card
- [ ] bom/templates uses shadow-lg

**Verify:** `grep -r "#[0-9a-fA-F]\{3,6\}" src/app/app/components src/app/app/warehouse src/app/app/goods-inwards src/app/app/bom/templates` returns no matches outside comments.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Reports — design system violations
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace all static inline `style={{color: …}}` in report pages with CSS module classes.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/valuation/page.tsx` + `valuation.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/movements/page.tsx` + `movements.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/po-summary/page.tsx` + `po-summary.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/po-variance/page.tsx` + `po-variance.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/lead-time-accuracy/page.tsx` + `lead-time-accuracy.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/dead-stock/page.tsx` + `dead-stock.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/reports/stocktake-history/page.tsx` + create `stocktake-history.module.css` if absent

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] No static style={{color}} in report pages
- [ ] Conditional colours use CSS classes
- [ ] Dynamic non-colour inline styles untouched

**Verify:** `grep -rn "style={{" src/app/app/reports` — output contains only dynamic non-colour values.
